title: ClearPath Rate on After-Hours Service Visits Drawn from TimeBank Blocks
content:
**Service ClearPath rate schedule.** The block hours of a weekday TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours service visit resolved in the onsite after-hours class for a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is active at ClearPath Professional are multiplied by 0.9; those of one for a client whose ClearPath agreement is active at ClearPath Standard, ClearPath Essentials or ClearPath Monitor, by 0.95; those of any other service visit, by 1.

| Visit | Client's active ClearPath tier | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| weekday, onsite after-hours class | ClearPath Professional | 0.9 |
| weekday, onsite after-hours class | ClearPath Standard, Essentials or Monitor | 0.95 |
| weekday, onsite after-hours class | ClearPath Premier or Enterprise, or no active agreement | 1 |
| Saturday or Sunday, or weekday business-hours class | any | 1 |

Hypothetical case: a weekday after-hours visit converting to 3.00 hours before this multiplier draws 2.70 hours for a ClearPath Professional client and 2.85 hours for a ClearPath Standard client.
